content.comment_body: Hello to everyone here. Thanks for all the valuable ideas shared in this forum. I've developed a menu structure for a [product_name] unit with several user-defined functions, and I'd like to offer it to others. It's not always about just taking from the community. I welcome any feedback or suggestions for improvement. (Is it necessary to activate these user-defined functions?) Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user shows appreciation for the community's support and is sharing a custom menu structure built for a [product_name] model using user-defined functions. They are seeking input and guidance for improvement, highlighting a collaborative and open approach to refining the configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to receive constructive feedback about the shared menu structure and guidance on whether the user-defined functions require activation.
